note: Start, End and Rotate (REVEAL-17), idempotent by command_id, on POST /campaigns/{campaign_id}/table-session: the path names the campaign. End and Rotate name their session, so a retried End of yesterday's session can never end today's; Start names none.

invalid.name: a start that names a session
invalid.why: Start makes a session; it names none

invalid.name: an end that names no session
invalid.why: an End names the session it ends

invalid.name: a rotate that names no session
invalid.why: a Rotate names the session it rotates

invalid.name: a null session id
invalid.why: send a session id, or leave the key out

invalid.name: the retired campaign id in the body
invalid.why: the path names the campaign; the body does not

invalid.name: the retired personal-link reset
invalid.why: threat model 15.11: there are no personal links

invalid.name: an action that does not exist
invalid.why: start, end or rotate; there is no pause

invalid.name: no command id
invalid.why: a retried Start must not start a second session

invalid.name: a command id too short to be a key
